texts.title: PABLO ESCOBAR
texts.wealth: In nineteen eighty-seven, Forbes put Pablo Escobar on its billionaire list. Think about that. A cocaine trafficker, listed alongside the world's richest people.
texts.social: But in parts of Medellín, there was another picture of him. He paid for homes and football fields. People had reasons to be grateful. That support mattered. Now listen to the other side of the story.
texts.questions: How does someone selling cocaine become powerful enough to challenge a government? And how does he convince some of the people living with that violence to see him as a hero?
texts.close: We're going back to Medellín, before the name took over the story.
